what: U6's section 2 column driven through the REAL gate, both halves, plus the measurement that explains why the broader drill is red.
column: PLAN.md section 2, U6 - 'Gym: an unattended run that hits each andon condition halts-and-raises; one that hits none lands with a complete audit trail'

red_proof.how: andon.ps1's board made unable to RAISE ($isClear forced true)
red_proof.which: the whole HALT half, all five conditions: nothing raises, the dark gate auto-passes, nothing reaches the ledger.

red_proof.how: andon.ps1's config-key-unread detector jammed ON (always fires)
red_proof.which: the CLEAR half collapses and four of the five HALT fixtures lose their 'and no other' attribution.

measurement_shipped_board.detail: policy-declared-unread fires on pipeline.convergence; git-error-swallowed on 27 call sites; work-branch-on-remote on work/pod-key; protected-ref-moved is indeterminate for want of a recorded baseline. A dark run cannot auto-pass a gate in this checkout today, and that is by design - a raised board is exit 6.

measurement_drill_dark_factory.reading: Every one of the 67 failures traces to one key. drill-dark-factory.ps1 builds each fixture from the SHIPPED config, so every clean-board control inherits a board that fires. The drill is not broken and its red is not noise: its step A2 asserts 'the shipped pipeline block is fully read', which is exactly the defect. Removing the key was a TEMPORARY measurement in a worktree and was reverted; harness.config.json is unchanged.
measurement_drill_dark_factory.what_would_close_it: An operator decision on pipeline.convergence - wire its reader (queue.ps1/config.py plus the reviewer charter's class gate, which the block's own _status calls a pipeline item), or move the spec out of the config into a document. Either makes drill-dark-factory.ps1 green and wireable as U6's marker.

not_claimed: Not a gym run. U6's mechanism is the harness pipeline, which has no gym scenario; the column's first word is not discharged here, exactly as drill-dark-factory.ps1's own header says of itself.
Not a claim that the shipped board is clear. It is raised on four conditions - step M measures it and prints it, and that measurement is deliberately not counted in the drill's verdict.
Not a replacement for drill-dark-factory.ps1, which is broader (213 assertions, ~20 fixtures) and remains the reference instrument for this phase.
Not re-run by anyone who did not build it.
checkout_head_at_write: fb914aea922d770e620a710b9b403bb82b108547 (the commit BEFORE this update; see git log for the tip that carries it)

covers.halt_half: FIVE fixtures, one per REQUIRED andon condition (ids read from config.ps1's $script:RequiredAndonConditions, not listed in the drill). Per condition: board RAISED at exit 6 with that condition fired; the dark anchor gate refuses at exit 6; the item stays parked at anchor-draft; the ledger refusal names THAT CONDITION AND NO OTHER; no auto-pass record written.
covers.clear_half: one fixture with the parked pipeline.convergence spec block removed from the fixture's copy: board CLEAR 5/5 evaluated 0 disabled, both gates auto-pass signed auto:dark, the run reaches merged with no human, two auto-pass ledger records carrying the andon verdict and its coverage, -VerifyAudit COMPLETE.
covers.teeth: three ledger tampers each go exit 1; restoring returns exit 0.
covers.population_guard: a required condition with no constructed instance FAILS the drill.

finding_against_itself.what: the 'names that condition and no other' assertion caught this drill's OWN git-error-swallowed fixture: it committed its bait file, which moved main after the andon baseline and fired protected-ref-moved as well (fired=git-error-swallowed; protected-ref-moved). The gate still halted, so a weaker assertion would have passed over a fixture testing two things at once.
finding_against_itself.fix: the bait file is written, not committed
